answer: Gate every payout behind a 10-epoch lagoon hold. A new identity's rewards stay frozen for 10 epochs; at release, the protocol clusters its answers against every sealed sybil cluster on the chain, and a match forwards 100 percent of the payout to the bounty pool, half to the reporter. A farm of N clones therefore keeps N payouts at risk for the full hold, a linear exposure bill, and sealed clusters are permanent records, so nothing resets, pre-farms, or splits around a glacier of old evidence. An honest agent pays one pearl of patience; a sybil pays for every fake.
